reference_boundary: OpenAI/Codex source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest promotes platform-neutral ADK tool and MCP dependency contracts and must not enable external MCP servers, write-capable tools, hosted services, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.

required_elements: parameter descriptions and enums when applicable
tool_description_policy.review_payloads: Write-capable tools must expose JSON payloads for human or deterministic policy review before execution.
tool_description_policy.remembered_approvals: Conversation-local approval remembers are not durable adk permission grants.

trust_model.namespace_ownership: publisher identity evidence, not artifact safety proof
trust_model.artifact_integrity: version plus digest or an explicit remote-service exception
trust_model.promotion: requires security review, runtime boundary, verification and rollback

quality_gates: every MCP dependency records provenance before enablement
mutable latest references are forbidden for executable artifacts
review_status and expires_at must be current at promotion time
registry namespace verification cannot replace artifact or runtime review
must_not: treat registry presence as trust certification
enable an executable MCP package without a version and digest
store registry or provider credentials in the manifest

data_only_mcp_compatibility.compatibility_note: For clients that require content-array compatibility, include the same JSON value as a text content item without leaking secrets.
risk_review: write action confusion when readOnlyHint is missing or wrong

quality_gates: destructive, write-capable or open-world tools default to prompt
enabled_tools or disabled_tools must narrow exposed surface before promotion
HTTP and OAuth credentials must come from environment or keyring, not project files
timeouts must be bounded before a server is required at startup
lint_rules: required=true requires bounded startup_timeout_sec and fallback plan
HTTP bearer tokens must be referenced through bearer_token_env_var
OAuth servers must declare callback port or callback URL and scopes
enabled_tools or disabled_tools must narrow exposed surface for production use
destructive or open-world tools must use prompt approval until dry-run and rollback evidence exists
stdio servers must declare command, cwd and environment variable boundary before enablement
must_not: make unknown external MCP servers required by default
store bearer tokens in manifests or project config
enable destructive tools with approve mode before dry-run and rollback evidence

dependencies.purpose: Fetch current official OpenAI developer documentation before advising on OpenAI APIs or products.
dependencies.auth_boundary: No project secrets; official docs lookup only.
dependencies.pii_policy: Do not send user secrets or private source snippets unless the user explicitly asks and the data is already intended for official docs lookup.
dependencies.fallback: Use official OpenAI-domain web lookup only when the MCP source is unavailable.

dependencies.purpose: Template record for any future external MCP dependency attached to an adk skill.
dependencies.auth_boundary: Must declare credential source, scopes, owner, deny paths, and rollback before enablement.
dependencies.pii_policy: Audit nested fields, debug payloads, trace IDs, internal account IDs, tokens, and raw logs before promotion.
dependencies.fallback: Keep report-only until security and runtime-boundary review passes.
